articles.title: Aku Sebelum Aku (2026)
articles.summary: Samehadaku is a prominent online platform highly favored by anime enthusiasts across Indonesia. It serves as an official and comprehensive streaming site, offering an extensive and regularly updated collection of anime content. A key feature is the provision of Indonesian subtitles, making it highly accessible and popular among local viewers seeking the latest anime releases and digital entertainment.

articles.title: ISRO revises voluntary retirement, resignation norms for scientists linked to Gaganyaan, key missions
articles.summary: The Department of Space has revised the authority and procedures for voluntary retirement and resignation for ISRO's Group 'A' Scientific and Technical personnel. This administrative update aims to streamline HR processes within India's premier space agency. For SSB aspirants, this highlights ongoing governance reforms and management of specialized talent in critical national scientific institutions, reflecting efficiency efforts in a strategic sector.

articles.title: Delhi HC to hear PIL alleging police surveillance of Cockroach Janta Party protesters on Monday
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court is set to hear a Public Interest Litigation (PIL) concerning alleged continuous police surveillance of protesters. This PIL raises crucial questions about civil liberties and law enforcement practices in a democracy, underscoring the judiciary's role in upholding fundamental rights. Aspiring officers should understand the balance between national security and citizens' right to protest peacefully.

articles.title: Delhi HC to hear PIL on July 20 over 'continuous, intrusive' surveillance at Jantar Mantar protest
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court will hear a Public Interest Litigation (PIL) on July 20, addressing allegations of "continuous, indiscriminate and intrusive surveillance" at an ongoing protest, likely Jantar Mantar. This legal development underscores concerns about privacy and civil liberties during public demonstrations, a crucial aspect of democratic functioning and fundamental rights for SSB aspirants to understand in the context of national governance.

articles.title: 22k gold rate today: Check 24k, 22k, 20k, 18k gold prices (July 17, 2026) at Tanishq, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Joyalukkas, Kalyan Jewellers and IBJA
articles.summary: Gold prices at leading Indian jewellery retailers witnessed a slight decline today, July 17, 2026, bringing relief to buyers. This reduction makes the yellow metal more accessible for those seeking lower rates. Such economic indicators are important for understanding national market trends and consumer sentiment, reflecting India's domestic financial landscape.

articles.title: Sweden's Saab posts record orders as fighter jet maker cashes in on higher defense spending
articles.summary: Swedish defense company Saab significantly surpassed Q2 earnings expectations, driven by a global boom in military equipment demand. The fighter jet manufacturer reported a record orders backlog, highlighting the current geopolitical trend of nations rapidly increasing defense spending and modernizing their forces. This signifies a growing global emphasis on national security and military preparedness, a key observation for aspirants.

articles.title: India's private space industry shoots for the stars
articles.summary: India's space sector is undergoing a major transformation, with private companies increasingly building rockets and satellites. This surge, following the government's decision to open the sector, is aimed at securing a larger share of the global space economy. It signifies a significant boost to India's indigenous technological capabilities and commercial footprint in space exploration and services.

articles.title: Ontario asks Ottawa for wildfire help amid calls to rebuild destroyed First Nation
articles.summary: A northern Ontario First Nation was devastated by wildfire, prompting the Assembly of First Nations to demand immediate federal government support. The provincial government also sought Ottawa's assistance for critical evacuation efforts. This highlights challenges in disaster response, inter-governmental coordination, and support for indigenous communities impacted by natural calamities, underscoring the importance of robust national emergency preparedness.
